title: Curiosity to Code: Turning Technical Ideas into Real Products
content: I have always been curious about how things work, how ideas become products, and how technology can solve real problems. I'm a developer who loves exploring systems, learning new paradigms, and turning concepts into reality. Developing, exploring, and building production software is just the beginning.

title: Winner: Lovable AI Web App Challenge by Brototype Malayalam
content: Selected as one of the 3 winners in the Lovable AI Web App Creation Challenge by Brototype Malayalam. Receiving personal recognition from Nikhil Kilivayil and Jobin Selvanose was a milestone that reinforces my passion for building, shipping, and pushing engineering boundaries.
